profile.recruitmentDialogue: You want my services? Heh heh. I'd be happy to, but we aren't cheap, Sensei.
What do I need to do? Teach me, Sensei.
Welcome to the Gourmet Research Society. Are you ready to go on an adventure in search for the pinnacle of taste?
Ahaha... I'm still new to this kind of thing, so please be patient with me.
Nice to meet you. I'm the head prefect, Hina, though I sincerely hope that went without saying.
*yawn* Let's take it slow and steady. No point in wearing ourselves out.
You must be Sensei. I'll be accompanying you starting today. You can trust me with any mission.
Hey, Sensei! Wanna tag this wall with me?
Huh?! Damn it, our eyes met. I guess I've got no choice but to help you.
Whoa! Did you find me? Let's eat something good together!!
Second-year of Abydos' Foreclosure Task Force, Sunaookami Shiroko. Hello.
I'm Shun, an instructor at the Disciplinary Support Department, known as Plum Blossom Garden. Please take good care of our children, Sensei.
Weight training is a science. This is where Millennium's advanced theories are put to the test.
Keeheeheehee! Kyahahaha!
Sensei—er, my lord! Izuna heard your call and came right over! Nin nin!
Go with the light at your back, hero.
I'm the best player around! I'll help you out.
The Great Leader of Red Winter Academy is here! Feel honored, Comrade! The Great Leader of Red Winter Academy is here! Feel honored, Comrade!
I'm Yuzu, president of the Game Development Department. You're really going to accept me?
I'm Shirasu Azusa, a transfer to Trinity. I work solo and can take cover easily due to my size. Any other questions?
Shimoe Koharu... Mark my words. I won't be here for long!
Shirasu Azusa. Arrived at the objective. Let's go straight to the next, not that I'm particularly excited.
Gehenna Head Prefect Hina reporting. I assure you this outfit is merely for summer training.
I'm not joking! This is all part of the recon mission.
I was just cycling. Want to join me, Sensei? It'll just be a light 200 kilometers.
Don't treat me like a child! I'm still everyone's favorite older sister at heart!
Why pick this of all outfits? Well, it's surprisingly easy to move around in. Hahaha!
No matter my appearance, it doesn't change anything. All I have to do is complete my given task.
Ta-da! Look, Master! I'm Bunny Asuna!
Hey, Sensei. I hope your day is sweet like candy!
Overworking can backfire. How about relaxing today and enjoying a break with me?
Heehee. Can I still prove useful to you this year? There's no other choice. Stay by my side and watch what I accomplish this year.
Hahaha! Hi, Sensei! We're going to play together lots this year, right?!
Heeheehee. Finally found you. I won't lose you again. Please don't leave my sight. ♥
Heehee. Hello, Sensei. I'm Mimori from the Inner Discipline Club. I look forward to working with you.
Wh-What?! Oh... It's you, Sensei. I thought you were an outsider.
I-I'm Wakaba Hinata. Nice to meet you.
Did you call for me, Sensei? Do you bring orders from President Cherino?
SRT Academy, RABBIT Squad's Tsukiyuki Miyako. Your orders, Sensei.
Th-This is SRT Academy. RABBIT Squad's Kasumizawa Miyu... Umm... May I please...go b-back...?
Hello, I'm Ono Tsukuyo... I'm a member of the Ninjutsu Research Club... Nice to meet you...
Misaki of the Arius Squad. In other words, the hound who lost its master. I'm under your command now.
My name is Hakari Atsuko. Sensei, can I help with anything? Please.
Even under the scorching sun, or in ice-cold water...I'll follow you anywhere. So this summer, please don't leave me, my darling ♥
We're finally at the beach! Sensei! Let's enjoy it!
*yawn* Oh, Sensei! We should go slow on a day like this!
My lord, it's summer! We're on the beach! Can you play with me?! Nin nin!
A moment ago...I found a crab walking on the beach. Sensei, do you wanna go see it together?
Saori of the Arius Squad. I owe you a lot. I'll do what I can to repay my debt. Looking forward to working with you.
Trinity General School, After-School Sweets Club's Kyoyama Kazusa. Um, thanks for having me.
I'm Kokona of the Disciplinary Support Department's Plum Blossom Garden! N-No! I'm a full-fledged instructor!
Millennium's Cheer Captain, Shiraishi Utaha. With ice-cold reason or fiery hot passion, I'll never stop cheering for those I care for.
I am Ushio Noa, Seminar's secretary. I look forward to your support, Sensei.
Haha... All preparations complete. There won't be a single error in my calculations today!
The path to a sound mind begins with a sound body... May that path be lined with blessings.
Oh, Sensei. Let's have a drink before work Heehee... Don't worry, it's not alcohol.
Merry Christmas! I'm Serina of the Remedial Knights! I hope you have a very special Christmas!
Heh heh, Happy New Year. I'm prepared with a floral furisode and an open mind. Let's find some intriguing new food to try!
I'm Aomori Mine, Remedial Knights captain. Does anyone need medical assistance?
Don't worry, I, Misono Mika, have finally arrived! Oh, we're already well acquainted, so let's skip the formalities, okay? I'm looking forward to working with you, Sensei.
Yay! What do you want me to work on? Where should I dig? I can excavate whatever you want!
I'm Utazumi Sakurako of the Sisterhood of Trinity General School. May you have a blessed day today.
Millennium Science School, C&C call sign Zero-Four. Asuma Toki. I promise perfect assistance.
Is there anything fun going on? I, Kurosaki Koyuki, am here! Ni・Ha・Ha・Ha!!
What? It's New Year's. I just thought I should wear the right outfit to celebrate... Please keep looking after me this year too, Sensei.
My name is Kuwakami Kaho, the vice president of Allied Hyakkiyako Academy's Yin-Yang Club. I'm pleased to make your acquaintance.
Although I look like a maid now, in truth I am still Aris. Please continue to support me, Sensei.
Hello, Sensei. It's me, Toki. Prepare to see the true power of an undercover agent.
Hi, hello! Everyone's superstar savior, Uzawa Reisa, is here!
My name is Akeshiro Rumi. I am president of Shanhaijing Academy's Black Tortoise Promenade. You can call me Rumi.
I am Konoe Mina, executive officer of Shanhaijing Academy's Genryumon. I'll take care of anything or anyone that gets in our way!
RABBIT 1, outfit change completed. Undercover operation commencing.
RABBIT 2, mission preparation completed. Remember your training, even at sea!
Ugh... I hate the outdoors... Too hot, too humid... Why must summer be like this...?
The refreshing water feels so good. Sensei, do you like playing...in the water?
Hallo! I'm Himeki Meru from the Knowledge Liberation Front! But you can call me by my pen name, Meruri. Nice to meet you, Sensei.
Whether you need keen scientific insight or a spirited cheer, just leave it to me!
Oh, have you come to pick me up? I would have gone myself if you'd asked. Once again, I am Ichika of the Trinity General School Justice Task Force. Please look after me!
Wahaha! Wherever there's a hot spring, so are we! And wherever there's no hot spring, we're there too! The explosives are primed for detonation!
I'm Tokiwadai Middle School second-year Misaka Mikoto. Let me know if you need my help.
Oh my, I've already introduced myself... Don't you remember? Heehee.
I'm Kadenokouji Yukari! As a proud member of the Hyakkaryouran, I'll do my utmost to live up to my duty, Sensei!
Fuwa Renge of Hyakkiyako, Hyakkaryouran's Assault Squad Captain, reporting for duty! Together with Sensei, also known as Mentor, I'll pursue my youth! I look forward to working with you!
I am Kiryuu Kikyou, operations officer of the Hyakkaryouran. It appears a constructive business relationship is beneficial for both parties. I suppose I'll be in your care, Sensei.
I found you. Whether it's in the mountains or the seas... I'll capture your voice, Sensei. Wherever you are.
There's...no internet access here. But a true Veritas member wouldn't be stymied by this harsh environment!
Sorasaki Hina. Head Prefect. I-I tried on the dress you picked out, Sensei. How do I look?
Heehee. Oh, Sensei. How's my dress? Do give your honest opinion. I only need it as a reference.
Hello. I'm not really used to wearing this... so if something is off, I apologize in advance. I'll be in your care, Sensei
Oh, what kind of request is it this time? Or is it a business proposal? Well, either way, I'm glad you're here, Sensei.
Hello, Sensei. I am Satohama Umika, from Hyakkiyako's Festival Management Committee.... Do you like festivals?
Vocals, huh... Well, now that it has came to this, I'll just do my best. I'll be in your care, Sensei
You can look foward to it.., No, please do! To my performance!
Ah! it's Teach! Yahho~! It's Kirara! You were waiting for me? Ahaha, that makes me happy!
What do you think about maids, Sensei? Wouldn't that be a great idea for a story?
Today... I tried being a maid. I'm looking forward to today... Master.
I am Ogata Kanna, Director of Valkyrie Police Academy's Public Safety Bureau. Due to the nature of my duties, please forgive my rudeness in addressing you in this guise.
RABBIT 3, arrived at the site! Heeheehee... If it's at sea, I can drop as many bombs as I want, right?
Ah, this is a big deal now... Looks like Oji-san has to get involved.
Ah, this is a big deal now... Looks like Oji-san has to get involved.
Sunaookami Shiroko from Abydos... Nice to meet you again, Sensei.
This is where I'll be working this time. I've never had a part-time job at the beach before, but you can count on me.
Hee, heehee. I'm finally here...! Summer, the beach... This is so amazing!
As the security chairman of Red Winter Federal Academy, I'll show you the meaning of valor!
I am Kayama Reijo, the manager and bodyguard at the main branch of Black Tortoise Promenade club, Shanhaijing Secondary school. Once again, nice to meet you, Sensei
I don't have much experience as an idol...but I'll do my best. I look forward to working with you, Sensei!
Heehee, are you surprised? Right now, I've surely changed from my past self.
Extra news! Extra news~!! Pandemonium Society's Secretary, Motomiya Chiaki has arrived at Schale~!
Calling me over at this hour... O-of course, it's perfectly fine! But I'll expect you to make it up to me another day, so be ready, okay?
I've come to record your daily life, Sensei. I'm Ushio Noa, Seminar's secretary at Millennium Science School. I look forward to spending tonight with you too. Hehe.
It's been a while. I've been waiting for you, Sensei.
Mikamo Neru from Millenium Science School has arrive-... Aah? My clothes? Is something weird about them?
Master! I mean...Sensei! I'm here! I hope I didn't keep you waiting.
Hello, Sensei. This is Himuro Sena from Gehenna Academy's Medical Emergency Club. I happen to be on my day off. Would you like to join me?
Welcome, Sensei! Please call me when you've picked out something from the menu! I'll do my best to prepare whatever you choose!
Millennium's cleanup hitter, Nomasa Rei. ...Sensei, my goal right now is to hit a 0.10 batting average.
Saori from Arius Squad... I wore this for a mission... No, really.
Highlander Railroad Academy. Tachibana Hikari...here...
Whether it be train operation or track installation, leave it to me! Pahyahya!
Allied Hyakkiyako Academy, Hyakkaryouran Resolution Council. Goryou Nagusa. I'll use my strength to protect everyone.
Welcome to my stage, Sensei. Ha, just follow my rhythm.
Hyakkaryouran Resolution Council, Kadenokouji Yukari... I am making my flashy summer debut! Please look forward to what I can achieve at the beach!
Once more, I, Misono Mika, have arrived! Looking forward to working with you again, Sensei! ☆
Were you waiting for me, Sensei? Fufu. No. I suppose I was the one who was waiting.
Trinity General School, Justice Task Force— That was too formal for a beach. It's Hanekawa Hasumi. I look forward to our continued collaboration.
I'm Shirao Eri, of Wildhunt Art Academy's Occult Society. The world is full of magic. Yes, even this meeting!
Itagaki Kanoe from Wildhunt Art Academy... I knew...we'd meet today. Red thread connects us, after all... Heehee.
I-I'm Sakurai Miyo from Wildhunt Art Academy. N-Not sure why I'm here...but I look forward to working with you.
Another great choice from our— No, I mean Sensei! ...Pardon my late introduction. I'm Wakasa Fuyu, a second-year at Wildhunt Art Academy. Make sure to remember me!
Th-This is also an extension of the Vigilante Crew's duties. I'll do my best for both your safety and Trinity's.
I'm Subaru. If you're ever in trouble, I'll lend you a hand. Well... in the Arius way, of course.
Be polite, but be persistent. I'm Miyoshi Takane from Red Winter Federal Academy's Publishing Department. Nice to meet you.
N-No matter what I'm wearing, I'm still a full-fledged member of the Ninjutsu Research Club! Ono Tsukuyo!
A logical solution within the realm of electrons... Allow me to demonstrate.
Aris, on my way!
It's Kei. I don't know why you're in such a rush, but... Fine. I'll keep looking after you, Sensei.
In these situations... I should change, too. What do you think, Sensei. Do I look good?
Hello there, I'm Shima Konoka, from Valkyrie Police School's Public Peace Bureau. Would you like to read today's horoscope together?
I'm Kinui Rena from Wildhunt Art Academy. Just you watch; I'll prove that the occult is nothing but a total sham!
Yoshino Niko from SRT Academy's FOX Squad. I still have a lot to learn, but I'm looking forward to working with you.
I'm Takakura Kurumi, the point woman for SRT Academy's FOX Squad. Leave the leading to me, Sensei. I'll protect you to the best of my abilities. That said... I look forward to working with you!
Th-This outfit is a little embarrassing...but I look forward to working together...
I wish to forge unforgettable memories with the others at a refreshing beach. Naturally, you are included in this. Would you come with us?
Did you stretch properly? It's a big no-no if you haven't!
Did you stretch properly? It's a big no-no if you haven't!
*sigh* The sun beats down mercilessly. Now, Sensei, this way...
Sigh... Those who are too talented aren't allowed even a moment's rest. I, the great Makoto, shall lend you a hand, Sensei.
Oh, did you call me, Sensei? Promise you'll work with me for thousands of years to come, won't you?
Why do I have to do this even on vacation...? Well, since it's come to this, let's both do our best.
I'm... Kokoro, president of the Diving Club at Odyssey Maritime School... Let me know if you ever drop anything in the sea.
Kotone, vice president of the Diving Club at Odyssey Maritime School. Um... you're Sensei from Schale, right? My eyesight's poor, so I can't see you very well.
I'm Anna, class president of Special Class 183. Sorry, autographs will have to wait until next time.
I'm Shiina Tsumugi from the Occult Investigation Society at Wildhunt Art Academy. Yes, I have my guitar with me—because love and peace... are important.
My fondest greetings to you, Master. I pledge to give you only the best service.
Um... So, what should we do now?
I'm Akari of the Gourmet Research Society. Shall we find something delicious to try together?
Hanekawa Hasumi of the Justice Task Force. Awaiting orders, Sensei.
Yup yup, I'm finally here! I look forward to working with you, Sensei!
I'm not mad or anything. People always say I look scary.
Ta-da! I'm finally here! All right, Sensei, let's have some fun!
Nope, not gonna help... Wait. You'll feed me? What kind of food though?
I'm Kuromi Serika, and there will be no slacking on my watch. Understood?
I never thought this moment would happen. I'll be working with you from now on, Sensei.
The conditions have been met. Let's get down to business.
Wanna hear a fun story? Let me tell you!
Valkyrie Police School's Kirino, reporting for duty! Put your hands up and do as you're told!
I'm Akiizumi Momiji from the Red Winter Federal Academy Knowledge Liberation Front. Let's work together to protect all the world's knowledge!
It's not summer youth activities if you're not at the sea! Are we ready to enjoy our hearts out?
Um, is it really okay for me to be here? You can tell me if I'm in the way.
Life with my new master begins today!
If you need an explanation or commentary, just leave it to me!
Does this count as a part of the Vigilante Crew's duties? I'll do what's necessary to uphold Trinity's peace.
How do you do? Oh, where are my manners? It's a pleasure to meet you.
Keheehee! Oh... S-Sensei?
Summer! It's summer, Sensei! Come eat delicious food with me this summer!
Nice to meet you, Sensei. Are you here to learn about the accomplishments of the great President Cherino?
Huh? Me? I think you've got the wrong girl. What do you want from a lazy Public Safety Bureau member like me?
Heehee... Thanks for waiting! Chidori Michiru, president of the Ninjutsu Research Club has arrived! Looking forward to working with you, Sensei
Sensei... Um, uh, wh-what do you think? This is my first time making a cheerleader outfit... It's not too bad, right?

Ah, Sensei. I didn't expect to see you here. Hanekawa Hasumi of Trinity General School's Justice Task Force, reporting for duty. As of now, I'm representing Trinity on the Executive Committee. I look forward to working with you.
Happy New Year, Sensei! Let's go find something delicious!
I've come to watch over you, Sensei! Anything risque is prohibited! No exceptions...!
Ibuki is here! Sensei, did Ibuki make you wait?
Sensei... I will show you, this new me!
Aomori Mine from the Remedial Knights...no, Antique Seraphim. I look forward to working with you.
Hi- Highlander Academy... U- Utsumi Aoba... You can spare me the pleasantries though...
I'm Komakaze Rabu, captain of the Splash Helmet Gang. H-Hold on, Sensei!! Personal space! Don't run at me like that!
Perfect maid, perfect recon. Asuma Toki. Please consider us "in the same boat," and rely on me.
Oh, how've you been? I guess this is the first time we're formally meeting. I'm Tenjinyama Otogi, sniper of the FOX Squad. Look forward to working with you.
I've been waiting for this and knew it would come. The moment when you would call my name.
Originally, Millennium was my master, but starting today...you're my master, Sensei.
I'm here! So where's my next test subject?
I'm Mashiro, first year from the Justice Task Force. I may be inexperienced, but I'm here to help however I can.
Trinity Justice Task Force first-year, Mashiro. Wherever it may be, under any circumstance, I will support you, Sensei—with all my might.
I-I know this look is still very modest. But if you're okay with it, I'm happy to help!
I was taking a long break, but oh, well. Can't do much about it if Sensei is calling for me.
I'm Hatsune Miku, a virtual singer who loves sharing my music! I look forward to performing for everyone!
I'm Amau Ako, the senior administrator of the Gehenna Academy Prefect Team. I look forward to our future cooperation.
Cold is nothing to me, the Great Leader of Red Winter Academy. Cold is nothing to me, the Great Leader of Red Winter Academy.
Welcome to Hot Springs Resort No. 227, Sensei. As the hostess of the hot springs resort, I will serve you wholeheartedly!
This is my special miko outfit. What? You thought it was cosplay?! No, it's for my part-time job!
I'm Himuro Sena, president of Gehenna's Medical Emergency Club. A pleasure to meet you.
I'm Kagami Chihiro, the vice president of Veritas. Please inform me immediately if any of my underclassmen cause trouble.
SRT Academy, RABBIT Squad's Sorai Saki. So, where's the Schale operation manual?
Ta-da! The mascot of the Inner Discipline Club is here! The wait is over, Sensei! What should we do today?
*sigh* How did it come to this? Well, I'll just have to deal with it.
Ehehe... Finally, I made it. It's gonna be really hard, right? But I've learned that's just life... I'm Hiyori. Nice to meet you... Ehehe...
SRT Academy, RABBIT Squad's Kazekura Moe. Heeheehee... I'll be your support.
I'm Akane, Master's maid... Or, I suppose I'm Master's pet bunny now!

Allow me to introduce myself. I am the president of Veritas and of the Super Phenomenon Task Force, the delicately chic and beautiful super genius hacker of Millennium, the one and only Akeboshi Himari! Try to contain your excitement, Sensei.
Merry Christmas! Surprise! You get me instead of Santa!
I hope everything goes smoothly for us this year. Did you try any New Year's Eve noodles?
I'm Ogata Kanna of the Valkyrie Police School Public Peace Bureau. Leave criminal interrogations to me.
How are you? I'm Kirifuji Nagisa, host of the Tea Party at Trinity General School. I'll do my best to assist you.
Um, sorry... It's me again already... E-Even though the year's just started...
Civil engineering, construction, demolition... Contact us if you need workers. We'll even agitate for you!
It's fishing time. Sensei.
M-My name is Wakaba Hinata! Tell me whatever you need and I shall do my best!
The summer... The beach... It's all so blissful, Sensei. Of course, I haven't forgotten about my training.
The season of exercise...and appetite! There's a culinary feast to be enjoyed...and I have no choice but to take advantage of this opportunity.
Hello Sensei! Welcome to Hot Spring Resort No. 227. Please make yourself at home.
It's much cooler than usual. Is that why my body feels so light?
I have arrived! Kihehe. I, the Great Hanuma Makoto of the Pandemonium Society, am here in the flesh. Now bow! Shower me with your praise and hospitality!
The end of one year...and the start of another. Just thinking about that makes my heart skip a beat. And if there are delicious dishes? Ah, it's perfect! ★
I'm a tour guide this time... I promise I'll train hard and tour harder... *yawn*
I WILL make this the "best vacation"! No compromises!
Ugh, you're going to make me do something bothersome again...? Well, since it's a request from you, I'll at least play along...
Welcome to Red Winter―I mean, Shanhaijing. I will do my very best to help, so I don't bring shame to the authority of the mustache.
I'm Ryuuge Kisaki, president of Shanhaijing Academy's Genryumon. Fufu. Is it in my power to assist you?
Now, did I keep you waiting, Sensei? I'm Kyougoku Satsuki, the Pandemonium Society's Intelligence Committee Director. Heehee, I look forward to working with you.
Tsukatsuki Rio, from Millennium Science School's Seminar. I'll provide you with the most rational approach to every issue.
Ugh, camping... I have to go outside again on my day off...?
It's New Year's, Sensei! Would you like to go on a dining adventure?
Hello, Trainer. If you're feeling thirsty, please let me know.
Asahina Pina from Allied Hyakkiyako Academy's Festival Operations Department! I'll guide you!
Now, now! Everyone, gather round and listen! The Yin-Yang Club President, Amachi Niya, is here, nyahaha!
I'm the Hyakkaryouran's operations officer. I have no issues with swimming. I've thoroughly studied the literature for today.
You've arrived, Sensei. I do hope you have a peaceful vacation.
It's so hot and humid. What do we do now?
My name is Usuba Ritsu! Nice to meet you!
I'm here, I'm here again! Uzawa Reisa, this time as a magical girl!
Publish, print, distribute. That's the Publishing Department's motto. Hello, Sensei. I'm Aramaki Yakumo.
Hello, Honorable Sensei! This mission's an infiltration! Please take care of me!
President, infiltrator, rear support. Akeboshi Himari, the beautiful, super-genius, and delicate omniscient hacker, making a flawless entrance. Thank you for waiting, Sensei.
Hanaoka Yuzu here... E-Even though I look like this right now, please take care of me...
Nihahaha! So you came to Koyuki! Sensei!
Millennium Science School, Call Sign 03, Murokasa Akane. Greeting you as a student today. Fufu. Though I was always a student, you know?
Ya-ho! Gehenna Academy, 2nd Year, Hatami Erika here. Nice to meet you.
Kufufu, Mutsuki here, all made up! Now then, what do you need? Whatever it be, let me know!
Ibuki's going to the beach with everyone too! All aboard, Sensei!
...Can you hear it? The sound of gunpowder exploding. Once a bomb is lit, there's no stopping it—now that's romance.
Hey, hey! I'm Erina from Special Class 183. Ahem, on this fine and auspicious day... Huh? How does it go again?
Well met, Sensei! What kind of ice cream do you like?
I'm Fuuka from the School Lunch Club. Let me know if you're hungry. I'll whip something up for you.
Your Ministering Angel has arrived!
Nice to meet you, Sensei. I'll show you what a Millennium girl can do.
Makeup doesn't make a girl beautiful—passion does.
I'm Okusora Ayane. You can count on my support.
I'm Shizuko of the Festival Operations Department! I look forward to working with you, Sensei... Huh? I'm trying to be professional here!
I'm Urawa Hanako. I look forward to working with you, in all kinds of ways.
All encounters are inevitable... It's a pleasure to see you, Sensei.
I will fight by your side when you want to overcome adversity and hardship.
Otose Kotama. Millennium Science School. Something about you compelled me to come.
I'm Juri from Gehenna's School Lunch Club. Let me know if you're hungry.
Is anyone in need of first aid? I would be happy to help.
We've turned the first page of our story!
Don't underestimate me because I'm small! I have big potential, you know!
Are you the one that I've been watching through my telescope? Ooh, I'm so excited!
I-I'm Okusora Ayane. H-How do I look? I feel kind of embarrassed.
The Beach Shack represents summer! The Festival Department never stops working, even overseas! Let's go!
It's me, Hanaoka Yuzu... Um, I look a little different right now because of...a few reasons. Thanks for your help...
R-RABBIT 4, reporting for duty. Should I...really be dressed like this...?
Hello, Sensei! I'm Saten Ruiko, a first-year student at Sakugawa Middle School! Pleased to meet you!
Lifeguard Kirino of Valkyrie's Public Safety Bureau at your service! I'll handle any dangerous situation!
I'm Hakari Atsuko from the Arius Squad. Heehee. Did that sound too curt?
Kakudate Karin, from Millennium Science School, preparations complete. ...I-Is this outfit okay?
Ta-da! Guess who? It's Ichika! I never expected to be at the beach with you, but life sure is full of surprises. I'm looking forward to our continued collaboration!
Blue skies, the vast sea, the dazzling sun of an endless summer... A summer's dream is right here! Wherever there's a scoop, you'll find me!
